message: 労働の対価

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hellooo~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry, but we don't have time to deal with you right now!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thought you'd say that~」

name: Synn
message: 「You came to help out」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahaha, no way~」

name: Misa
message: 「In the first place, why are you even here, Takahashi!? Don't you have your own duties to take care of?」

name: Ria
message: 「Come to think of it, has that indiscriminate pickup artist still not been caught?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio is chasing after him, but it seems he's pretty fast on his feet」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh! That guy hit on me too~ I was on my way here so I ignored him, though~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ew. Truly indiscriminate」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so on--we have a mountain of problems. Therefore, Mr. Treasurer, please do something about this friend of yours」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, that's the situation」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Like I said! I figured you guys were busy, so I brought reinforcements~」

name: Synn
message: 「Reinforcements?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I caught him in an empty classroom~ So feel free to use him however you like~」

name: Ria
message: 「Listen, Takahashi. I don't think forcing someone is right\s01」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well then, I'll leave the rest to you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, get baaaaack here...... She's always so fast when running away」

name: Misa
message: 「So, what are you going to do?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, what am I going to do?」

name: Azel
message: 「......I'm going home」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now, don't say that. Once you join in, it's actually quite fun」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Speaking from my rich and splendid life experience, the best thing to do is just participate for now」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I participated, and participated, and participated, and finally arrived at the fun Student Council!」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm going home」
Hm? Wait a second, this might be my chance!

name: Synn
message: 「Hold it right thereee!」
With this event, I'll get Azel to blend right into the academy all at once!
In that case, right here, I have to take the plunge!

name: Synn
message: 「How about one day's worth of cafeteria food!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, even if you take the plunge, that's about as far as you go, Synn...」

name: Misa
message: 「Isn't that bri--mmph, mmph」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Madam Vice President. You mustn't interrupt an interesting negotiation」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm going home」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah... Th-Then two days' worth!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!? There's no way you can afford that」
There are times when a Student Council President has to do what he has to do.

name: Synn
message: 「You can order whatever you want at Prier!」

name: Ria
message: 「Listen, Synn. I think anything too expensive is going to be a problem」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, before that, it's just impossible」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so! I can't back down here!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Those are serious eyes」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Synn, you're amazing!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll pitch in too! I'll cover up to half!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, but, this is something I, as Student Council President」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't worry about it! Leave half of it to me!」

name: Azel
message: 「Two days' worth of Vandine Jelly」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not something like that...」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't have any favorites」

name: Synn
message: 「Then it doesn't really have to be that...」

name: Azel
message: 「That's fine」

name: Synn
message: 「...Got it. Two days' worth of Vandine Jelly, right」

name: Azel
message: 「It's a deal」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, it's burning, it's burning!」
I frantically stir the yakisoba with a spatula.

name: Synn
message: 「You have to stir it like this so it cooks evenly」

name: Azel
message: 「Too much trouble」

name: Synn
message: 「...The deal」

name: Azel
message: 「What's next?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, first you pour sauce on for seasoning」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't dump the whole thing on!」

name: Azel
message: 「Pitch black」
I-I can't eat this...
Still, it'd be a waste... I'll ask Eauderourke if he'll eat it later.

name: Azel
message: 「What do I pour on next?」

name: Synn
message: 「...My bad for making you do something so hard right off the bat」

name: Synn
message: 「Then... peel the potatoes over here」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is that terrifying way you're holding the knife!」

name: Azel
message: 「Stab」

name: Synn
message: 「What good would stabbing me do!?」
Taking the knife away from Azel, who was holding it at his hip like he was in a yakuza turf war.

name: Azel
message: 「Is that wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, very wrong. You hold it like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't point the blade up... W-woah! Don't swing it around!」
How dangerously perilous!

name: Azel
message: 「Can't stab」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't need to stab it, don't stab it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Just like that, onto the potato」

name: Azel
message: 「Stab」

name: Synn
message: 「Not like that! Do it just like I'm doing, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Like this, press the knife in shallowly and slowly peel the skin with a gliding motion」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, that's way too deep!」
At that rate, there won't be anything left after peeling!

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up」

name: Azel
message: 「Peeled」
Just as expected, nothing was left after he finished peeling.

name: Synn
message: 「Listen... Never mind this part, could you crack the eggs for me?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're just slamming them down right off the bat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... Have you never cracked an egg before?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm cracking it」
Sure, slamming it down will break it, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Could you hand out those balloons?」

name: Synn
message: 「All you have to do is stand there holding the balloons. Then, just hand one to anyone who comes up to you and you're golden」

name: Synn
message: 「Here」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, let's practice a bit」
I walk up to Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you hand me all of them...」

name: Azel
message: 「Done」

name: Synn
message: 「Not like that! One per person!」

name: Synn
message: 「We're doing it one more time」
Mhm. He handed it to me.
Not just a little, he's way too unfriendly... though maybe asking for more is impossible.
Besides, if he's surrounded by kids' smiles, even Azel is bound to stop being so standoffish.

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah, yeah, just like that」
I handed back the balloon I'd received.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. That was just practice, so it doesn't count」
Now then, let's see how Azel is doing...
Whoa. Way too unfriendly. Even the kids look hesitant to take one.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, uh... do you think you could be a little more friendly?」

name: Synn
message: 「With stuff like this, I think it's better if the person handing them out looks like they're having fun. It makes it easier for them to take a balloon, too」

name: Azel
message: 「It isn't fun」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But look, once the kids start coming over, it'll get fun. So come on, try smiling just a tiny bit」

name: Azel
message: 「You ask for a lot」

name: Synn
message: 「Contract」

name: Azel
message: 「Grin」
Wawah. The kids are receding like an ebbing tide!

name: Azel
message: 「So fun」
Does it have to be a job where it's fine to look unmotivated and unfriendly, and barely move at all...?
So with that, I had Azel stand around holding a sign, and yet...
He's literally just standing there...
This feels wrong, totally wrong!
Wait a second, before I knew it, the goal became making him work, completely drifting away from the point of getting him to have fun!

name: Man
message: 「Mademoiselle. Would you care to enjoy an elegant afternoon tea with me?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, ah, um, I'm on the Kira-Fes executive committee, so」
Wawah. Over there, Ria-senpai is getting hit on!?

name: Man
message: 「Acquiring a splendid tea set at this very venue just moments ago must have been a harbinger of my meeting you」
With an utterly casual motion, the thoroughly suspicious, suave man took Ria-senpai's hand and

name: Man
message: 「And labor does not suit a young lady's lovely fingers at all. Those fingers are meant solely for enjoying an elegant teatime with me」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, please don't do that」

name: Man
message: 「Even your troubled expression is quite lovely. There's a cafe just over there that serves rather delicious black tea――」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai clearly doesn't want this, so please stop!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Synn-kun」

name: Man
message: 「And might you be her lover, then?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I'm not!」

name: Man
message: 「In that case, sticking your nose into someone else's romance is rather uncouth」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Romance!?」

name: Man
message: 「You're still young, so I suppose it can't be helped if you don't understand. However, such behavior can hardly be called refined」

name: Ria
message: 「There isn't any romance to begin with!」

name: Man
message: 「That is only because you haven't noticed it yet」

name: Shio
message: 「Hold it right there!」

name: Man
message: 「Hmph」
The man lightly dodged Shio-chan's naginata.

name: Man
message: 「Deep jealousy is also one of a woman's charms」

name: Shio
message: 「Gah, stand still and face your judgment!」

name: Man
message: 「Slaying the man you love to make those feelings eternal... I'm almost moved by that passion of yours」

name: Shio
message: 「Do not jest with me, you insolent cur!」

name: Man
message: 「Winning over someone who plays hard to get is also one of the true pleasures of love」

name: Shio
message: 「Gah, stop darting around!」

name: Man
message: 「Scattering my life before your passion wouldn't be a bad way to end things, I suppose, though now is not yet the time」
Shio-chan's attacks don't even graze him.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Ria
message: 「That guy isn't normal」

name: Shio
message: 「If thou wishest for the end so badly, I am not unwilling to oblige!」

name: Man
message: 「As long as there are encounters yet unseen, I simply cannot die」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, I can tell. He's an eccentric, isn't he」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not what I meant... He's parrying Shio-chan's attacks without barely moving」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmph, take this, ha!」

name: Man
message: 「Your form of love is beautiful. However, rather than such a form of love, why not savor a different kind of love?」

name: Shio
message: 「Hah!」

name: Man
message: 「Your valiant figure is lovely as well, yet--」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What?」
Before anyone realized it, the man had slipped behind Shio-chan.

name: Shio
message: 「Kyaaaaah!」
He trailed a finger lightly down her slender back, and

name: Shio
message: 「What dost thou think thou art doing, fiend to maidens!」

name: Man
message: 「A flower tinged with shyness is also worthy of admiration」

name: Shio
message: 「Guh!」
Shio-chan leaped away as if flying and readied her naginata once more.

name: Shio
message: 「Enough of this mockery!」

name: Man
message: 「To become so bloodthirsty over something of this degree--your life training is still sorely lacking」

name: Shio
message: 「Judgment!」
A godspeed thrust that seemed utterly impossible to evade lunged at the man.

name: Man
message: 「Heh. I have certainly received your passion」

name: Shio
message: 「N-No way...」
The man had caught the tip of her naginata with a signboard he had casually snatched from Azel.

name: Man
message: 「However, you must not let yourself be driven by such a trifling surge of emotion to take a life」
With a snap, the half of the signboard severed by the naginata fell right onto the man's toes.

name: Synn
message: 「That looks painful」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah. Um, are you okay?」

name: Man
message: 「It is nothing worth troubling a lovely mademoiselle over. After all, pain is part and parcel of love」
The man's gaze turned toward Shio-chan, who was still standing there in a daze.

name: Man
message: 「The world is beautiful. Those who live are beautiful for that alone. You must never forget that」
Then, his gaze locked onto Azel.

name: Man
message: 「Though, perhaps you do not feel the same way」

name: Azel
message: 「...Shut up」

name: Man
message: 「Words unpleasant to the ear are always grating. However, irritating a lady any further is not my intention」
With those words, the man gave a bow, and.

name: Man
message: 「Farewell!」
Just as a massive flurry of rose petals suddenly swirled wildly through the air, the man slipped away in the commotion.

name: Shio
message: 「...I still lack sufficient training... To have that pointed out by such a frivolous man... H-How humiliating」

name: Ria
message: 「You drove him off for now, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah, all's well that ends well」

name: Shio
message: 「Once this festival is over, I intend to seclude myself in the mountains for about three days. Please tell my elder sister not to worry if she cannot reach me」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you know that guy?」

name: Azel
message: 「Never seen him」

name: Synn
message: 「...Really?」

name: Azel
message: 「Never seen him」
She didn't leave any room to pry.
Still, that was just how Azel always acted, so there was no way to read anything into her attitude.
Even so, what was with that loaded remark of his...
